phases.1: 1 · Find out what the server offers

explain.question: The caller's question enters the agent. Nothing about tools is known yet.
explain.discover: The connector asks the server who it is and what it can do - a single stateless request, no session.
explain.discover_result: The server answers with its name, version, protocol, and the capability groups it offers.
explain.tools_list: The connector asks for the list of tools, each with a description and a JSON Schema for its inputs.
explain.tools_list_result: The tool names, descriptions and input schemas. The agent passes these to the model unchanged.
explain.prompts_list: The connector asks which prompts the server publishes.
explain.prompts_list_result: The prompts on offer, each with its arguments.
explain.llm_tool_request: The agent sends the question and the tool descriptions to the model and asks which tool, if any, to call.
explain.llm_tool_call: The model answers with a function call: tool name and arguments.
explain.llm_tool_done: The model says it has enough. The tool loop ends.
explain.tool_call: The connector sends a tools/call request. The server validates the arguments and runs it.
explain.backend_search: Inside the server: the question is embedded and searched. Plain code, not MCP.
explain.backend_result: Ranked results come back from the data source to the server.
explain.ticket_request: Inside the server: the query is sent to an external REST API. Not MCP.
explain.ticket_result: Results come back from the external API to the server.
explain.backend_error: The data source failed. The server turns this into a tool error the model can read.
explain.tool_result: The tool's result: structured content plus a text version.
explain.tool_error: The tool ran but failed. The error travels back as a result so the model can react to it.
explain.prompt_get: The connector fetches the prompt the agent chose, filled with its declared arguments.
explain.prompt_result: The prompt text: how the answer must be written.
explain.llm_answer_request: The agent sends the instructions and the retrieved text to the answer model.
explain.answer: The agent returns the answer to the caller.
explain.host_decision: A decision the agent made on its own, without calling the model or the server.
explain.wire_request: What actually went over HTTP: one request carrying one JSON-RPC message.
explain.sampling: The server asks to borrow the agent's model (sampling/createMessage).
explain.elicitation: The server asks the caller a question (elicitation/create).
